_doc: Cultivator professions. XP to go from rank r to r+1 = xp_base * xp_growth^r. Working earns xp per day scaled by primary_attribute/10, and spirit stones = work_income * (rank+1) per 30 days.

professions.name: Alchemist
professions.description: Refines spirit herbs into pills and elixirs.

professions.name: Blacksmith
professions.description: Forges and refines magical artifacts and weapons.

professions.name: Talisman Master
professions.description: Inscribes talismans that store spells for later use.

professions.name: Array Master
professions.description: Builds formations that defend, trap, gather qi, or kill.

professions.name: Doctor
professions.description: Heals injuries of body, meridian and soul.
